## Checklist

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && pytest`)
- [ ] Frontend tests pass (`cd frontend && npm test`)
- [ ] Lint/typecheck pass (`ruff check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] If calculation behavior changed: `CALC_VERSION` bumped and
      `docs/METHODOLOGY.md` updated to match
- [ ] No real property data, client information, credentials, or secrets added
- [ ] New numbers shown to users are explainable (breakdown, unit math, or
      audit event — no black boxes)
